completion_promises.criterion_text: Filtered retrieval prefers primary-text chunks over secondary at equal score (covers @key-example @smoke @retrieval @primary scenario "retrieves source-filtered chunks")
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _primary_first() in src/study_tutor/knowledge/retrieval.py which partitions ranker output into PRIMARY_TEXT first then SECONDARY_*. test_retrieve_primary_first_at_equal_score interleaves 3 primary + 3 secondary chunks at the same distance and asserts indices [0,1,2] are all primary, [3,4,5] all secondary. Seam test test_retrieve_returns_primary_first_with_citation_anchors validates the SourceTypedCorpus contract.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Top-K boundary: 7 available primary chunks → 6 returned; 0 available → empty list; 3 → 3 returned (covers @boundary @retrieval Scenario Outline)
completion_promises.evidence: retrieve() takes top_k=DEFAULT_TOP_K (6) and applies (primary + secondary)[:top_k] in _primary_first. Parametrised test_retrieve_top_k_boundary covers (0,3,6,7) → (0,3,6,6).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Retrieval for a text_name with no primary edition returns [] and the orchestrator records `no primary-text edition available` reason (covers @negative @retrieval scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: retrieve() returns [] when (a) no collection provider is wired, (b) the provider yields None, or (c) the where-filter on text_name yields zero rows. test_retrieve_empty_corpus_returns_empty_list and test_retrieve_returns_empty_when_no_collection_provider cover both empty-corpus shapes.

completion_promises.criterion_text: AQA-pattern filename in chunk metadata is excluded at retrieval-time even if present in the collection (covers @negative @retrieval @copyright scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: AQA_FILENAME_PATTERN regex defined at module level (mirrors corpus.AQA_REFUSAL_PATTERN). _passes_aqa_filter() drops any chunk whose Path(source_path).name matches; applied in retrieve() before reranking. test_retrieve_filters_aqa_filename_defence_in_depth covers past_paper, mark-scheme, and examiner_report variants.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Reranker unavailability does not block the turn — chunks returned in base similarity order with mode="no_rerank" recorded (covers @edge-case @retrieval @resilience scenario)
completion_promises.evidence: _load_reranker() either delegates to _reranker_factory or imports sentence_transformers.CrossEncoder lazily; ImportError is caught in retrieve() which then sets _last_retrieval_mode = MODE_NO_RERANK and returns _primary_first(chunks, top_k) using the chromadb-distance ordering. RERANKER_MODEL="BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3" is held as a module-level constant. test_retrieve_falls_back_when_reranker_unavailable verifies chunks are returned, primary-first holds, and get_last_retrieval_mode() returns MODE_NO_RERANK. test_retrieve_records_mode_rerank_on_success_path verifies the success branch records MODE_RERANK.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Filter excludes context_historical/ chunks for non-AO3 turns (the four-folder layout invariant)
completion_promises.evidence: NON_AO3_SOURCE_TYPES = (PRIMARY_TEXT, SECONDARY_STUDY_GUIDE, SECONDARY_CRITICAL) — CONTEXT_HISTORICAL is intentionally excluded.
